description: This file defines an abstract class AwsCredentialIdentity within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a standard AWS credential identity with an abstract method to retrieve expiration information.

classes.name: AwsCredentialIdentity
classes.description: An abstract class representing AWS credential identity, providing an interface for credential-related information such as expiration.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: An abstract method to retrieve the expiration timestamp of the credential; returns null if no expiration information is available.
